name: Victorian Debutante
source:
Simple visual novel in which you play as a young upperclass woman preparing for her debut before the Queen and her royal relatives. All of your decisions lead to one of four very different endings. Who will you become? The jewel of the season or the outcast, never again mentioned by your family?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1878110/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
简单的视觉小说，你在其中扮演一位年轻的上流社会女性，准备在女王和她的皇室亲戚面前首次亮相。你的所有决定都会导致四种截然不同的结局之一。你会成为谁？是本季的瑰宝，还是家人再也没有提及的被遗弃者？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1878110/]Steam[/url]]
